title: pnpm check shows why a check failed, and changed branches get a coverage line
notes: Retro 2026-11-24: after a FAIL, workers grepped check.log 7 times and one re-ran pnpm lint. scripts/check.mjs's summary prints the first few failure lines under each FAIL (the failing test names, the tsc errors, the eslint lines). Also 4 of 21 pr-loop findings were new branches with no test (workflow-rule-2): add a coverage report of the files changed against main, in CI or as a fourth check, if it stays cheap; say in the PR if it is not.

comments.body: Pull request #351 opened: pnpm check shows why a check failed, and a coverage line for the change https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/351
